description: This Java class 'HttpRequestPropertiesMatcher' is part of the mockserver project, responsible for matching HTTP request properties against expectations, including method, path, headers, body, cookies, and other request attributes. It supports complex matching logic and logging of match outcomes.

classes.name: HttpRequestPropertiesMatcher
classes.description: A matcher class for HTTP request properties, supporting complex matching logic for various request attributes and detailed logging.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Determines if a given request definition matches the criteria defined in this matcher.

methods.name: getHttpRequest
methods.description: Returns the current HttpRequest being matched.

methods.name: getHttpRequests
methods.description: Returns a list of HttpRequests associated with this matcher.

methods.name: withControlPlaneMatcher
methods.description: Sets whether the matcher operates in control plane mode.

methods.name: matches
methods.description: Performs detailed matching of an HttpRequest against the stored criteria, including body, headers, path, method, etc.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Serializes the HttpRequest to JSON string for debugging.

methods.name: fieldsExcludedFromEqualsAndHashCode
methods.description: Returns fields excluded from equals and hashCode methods.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on HttpRequest and relevant fields.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes hash code based on HttpRequest and superclass.
